description: This PHP class 'Required' defines a validation rule for checking the presence of input data, with an option to exclude empty strings. It is part of a validation library used within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the API validation rules.

classes.name: Required
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a given input is present, with an option to consider empty strings as empty. It extends AbstractRule and uses the IsEmptyTrait for utility methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes whether empty strings should be excluded when validating.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation check to confirm if the input value is considered present, respecting the excludeEmptyString flag.
